content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: The House of Representatives has passed an economic stimulus bill aimed at boosting the economy through tax cuts and infrastructure investments, but the measure faces significant hurdles in the Senate.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The bill, which includes $1 trillion in infrastructure spending and a reduction in corporate taxes, is designed to stimulate job growth and revitalize the economy.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Democrats are largely supportive of the bill, viewing it as a crucial step in addressing the lingering effects of the pandemic.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: However, Republicans argue that the bill is too costly and could lead to inflationary pressures.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: A senior senator warned, 'We need to be cautious about adding more debt to the national balance sheet at this critical time.'

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: 'This bill is essential for our economic recovery,' said Representative Martinez.
